ov: About 155 species of small, stout rodents, sometimes called meadow or field mice, related to lemmings and hamsters. They breed fast: litters come monthly from spring to autumn, and the young can breed themselves at a month old.
rg: Across North America, Europe and Asia.
df: Plants; a vole eats its own body weight in plant material every 24 hours.
fx: Most voles live no longer than 16 months in the wild.
Some vole species have males and females with different numbers of chromosomes.
